title: OpenDEA Compatibility Metadata
description: Explicit compatibility declaration for a model version. SemVer alone is insufficient — adding a question can change the statistical interpretation of a score (CR-AM-01 §25 + CR-AM-02 §11). Each axis is independent: a model can declare schema/semantic/scoring/maturity/result/benchmark compatibility independently. Default behaviour: a model version that is silent on compatibility is treated as compatible on every axis (CR-AM-02 §11 default-shape rule).

schema.description: Schema-compatible: existing JSON Schema validators will accept documents produced by the new version without modification. CR-AM-02 §11.

semantic.description: Semantic-compatible: every construct present in the previous version continues to mean the same thing in the new version. CR-AM-02 §11.

scoring.description: Scoring-compatible: a result produced under the new version can be treated as scored under the old version without re-mapping. CR-AM-02 §11.

maturity.description: Maturity-interpretation-compatible: a result interpreted under the new version can be re-interpreted under the old version with the same level/range attribution. CR-AM-02 §11.

result.description: Result-structure-compatible: results produced under the new version preserve the lineage of results produced under the old version. CR-AM-02 §11.

benchmark.description: Benchmark-compatible: results from the new version may legitimately participate in cross-organisation benchmarking with results from the old version. CR-AM-02 §11.
